```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  echo = TRUE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6,
  fig.align = "center",
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r load}
library(censusindia)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

state <- get_population(geography = "state") |>
  filter(state_name_harmonized != "India")
india <- get_population(geography = "state") |>
  filter(state_name_harmonized == "India")
dist <- get_population(geography = "district")
lgd <- get_population(geography = "district", boundary = "lgd")
```

```{r design}
INK <- "#1c1c1c"
INK_MUTED <- "#6b6b6b"
ACCENT <- get_palette("blues")[8]
DIV_LOW <- get_palette("blue_red")[2]
DIV_MID <- "grey92"
DIV_HIGH <- get_palette("blue_red")[10]
YEAR_COLS <- c(`2011` = "#999999", `2031` = ACCENT)

theme_proj <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.15), colour = INK),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK_MUTED, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = INK_MUTED, size = rel(0.8), hjust = 0),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    axis.title = element_text(colour = INK_MUTED, size = rel(0.9)),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = INK_MUTED),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(0.8), colour = INK),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm")
  )
theme_set(theme_proj)

theme_map <- theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = INK),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK_MUTED, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    legend.position = "right", legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

SRC <- "Source: MOHFW, Population Projections for India and States 2011-2036 (Census 2011 base)"
```

```{r national, fig.height = 8}
nat <- india |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    increment = population - lag(population),
    sex_ratio = 1000 * females / males
  )

ends <- filter(nat, year %in% c(2011, 2036))

p_pop <- ggplot(nat, aes(year, population / 1e9)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = ACCENT) +
  geom_point(data = ends, size = 2.2, colour = ACCENT) +
  geom_text(
    data = ends,
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f B", population / 1e9)),
    vjust = -1.1, size = 3.4, colour = INK
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Billions",
    title = sprintf(
      "India's population is projected to increase by %.0f million between 2011 and 2036",
      diff(range(ends$population)) / 1e6
    )
  )

p_inc <- ggplot(filter(nat, !is.na(increment)), aes(year, increment / 1e6)) +
  geom_col(fill = ACCENT, width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Millions added",
    title = sprintf(
      "Annual additions fall from %.1f to %.1f million",
      nat$increment[2] / 1e6, nat$increment[nrow(nat)] / 1e6
    )
  )

p_sr <- ggplot(nat, aes(year, sex_ratio)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = ACCENT) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Females per 1,000 males",
    title = sprintf(
      "National sex ratio is projected to rise from %.0f to %.0f",
      nat$sex_ratio[1], nat$sex_ratio[nrow(nat)]
    ),
    caption = SRC
  )

patchwork::wrap_plots(p_pop, p_inc, p_sr, ncol = 1)
```

```{r trajectories, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 9.5}
india_idx <- india |>
  mutate(index = 100 * population / population[year == 2011]) |>
  select(year, india_index = index)

idx <- state |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  mutate(
    index = 100 * population / population[year == 2011],
    final = index[year == 2036]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, -final)) |>
  left_join(india_idx, by = "year")

ggplot(idx, aes(year)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = india_index), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = index), colour = ACCENT, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~state_name_harmonized, ncol = 6, labeller = label_wrap_gen(18)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2011, 2036), labels = c("'11", "'36")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(100, 200, 400, 800)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Population index (2011 = 100, log scale)",
    title = "Population projections per state (basis 2011 population)",
    subtitle = "Log scale: parallel slopes = equal growth rates. Ordered by 2036 index. Grey line = India",
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r growth-heatmap, fig.height = 9}
gr <- state |>
  arrange(state_name_harmonized, year) |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  mutate(growth = 100 * (population / lag(population) - 1)) |>
  mutate(final_growth = growth[year == 2036]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(growth)) |>
  mutate(state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, final_growth))

ggplot(gr, aes(year, state_name_harmonized, fill = growth)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = DIV_LOW, mid = DIV_MID, high = DIV_HIGH, midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-0.5, 2.5), oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Annual growth (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(2015, 2035, 5)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    title = "Year-on-year growth rate by state, 2012-2036",
    subtitle = "Ordered by 2036 growth rate. Blue = shrinking. Scale capped at 2.5% (Daman & Diu, D&NH run to 12%)",
    caption = SRC
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "cm"))
```

```{r terminal-growth, fig.height = 8}
XMAX <- 2.3

term <- gr |>
  filter(year == 2036) |>
  mutate(
    state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, growth),
    shrinking = growth < 0,
    shown = pmin(growth, XMAX)
  )

ggplot(term, aes(shown, state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = shown, yend = state_name_harmonized, colour = shrinking), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = shrinking), size = 2.4) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(term, growth > XMAX),
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% >", growth)), hjust = 1.15, size = 3, colour = INK
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = DIV_HIGH, `TRUE` = DIV_LOW), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(NA, XMAX)) +
  labs(
    x = "Growth in the final projected year (%)", y = NULL,
    title = "Tamil Nadu is the only state shrinking in 2036",
    subtitle = "Two UTs run off-scale; their values are labelled",
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r share, fig.height = 8}
shares <- state |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2036)) |>
  left_join(select(india, year, national = population), by = "year") |>
  mutate(share = 100 * population / national) |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, year, share) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = share, names_prefix = "s") |>
  mutate(change = s2036 - s2011) |>
  filter(s2011 > 0.5) |>
  mutate(state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, change))

ggplot(shares, aes(y = state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = s2011, xend = s2036, yend = state_name_harmonized),
    colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = s2011), colour = "grey55", size = 2.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = s2036, colour = change > 0), size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = DIV_LOW, `TRUE` = DIV_HIGH),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Losing share", `TRUE` = "Gaining share"), name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of India's population (%)", y = NULL,
    title = "Bihar gains the most national share, Tamil Nadu loses the most",
    subtitle = "Grey point = 2011, coloured point = 2036. States above 0.5% share in 2011",
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r increment, fig.height = 8}
incr <- state |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2036)) |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, year, population) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = population, names_prefix = "p") |>
  mutate(added = p2036 - p2011) |>
  arrange(desc(added)) |>
  mutate(
    cum_share = 100 * cumsum(added) / sum(added),
    rank = row_number()
  )

p_add <- incr |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(added / 1e6, reorder(state_name_harmonized, added))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = ACCENT) +
  labs(
    x = "Millions added", y = NULL,
    title = "Where India's next 311 million people are added",
    subtitle = "Top 20 states by absolute increment, 2011-2036"
  )

p_cum <- ggplot(incr, aes(rank, cum_share)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(50, 75), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_step(colour = ACCENT, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 37)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of states (ranked by increment)", y = "Cumulative share of increment (%)",
    title = "Uttar Pradesh and Bihar supply a third of the increment",
    caption = SRC
  )

patchwork::wrap_plots(p_add, p_cum, ncol = 1, heights = c(1.6, 1))
```

```{r sex-ratio-states, fig.height = 8}
sr <- state |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2036)) |>
  mutate(sex_ratio = 1000 * females / males) |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, year, sex_ratio) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = sex_ratio, names_prefix = "sr") |>
  mutate(state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, sr2036))

ggplot(sr, aes(y = state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = sr2011, xend = sr2036, yend = state_name_harmonized),
    colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = sr2011), colour = "grey55", size = 2.4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = sr2036, colour = sr2036 > sr2011), size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = DIV_HIGH, `TRUE` = DIV_LOW),
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Worsening", `TRUE` = "Improving"), name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Females per 1,000 males", y = NULL,

    subtitle = "Grey point = 2011, coloured point = 2036. Dashed line = parity",

  )
```


```{r rankings, fig.height = 8}
rank_data <- state |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2036)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(rank = rank(-population, ties.method = "first")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(rank <= 15) |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, year, rank) |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  mutate(delta = if (n() < 2) NA_real_ else rank[year == 2036] - rank[year == 2011]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(moved = case_when(
    is.na(delta) ~ "Entered / left",
    delta < 0 ~ "Rose",
    delta > 0 ~ "Fell",
    .default = "Unchanged"
  ))

ggplot(rank_data, aes(factor(year), rank, group = state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = moved), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = moved), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = state_name_harmonized, hjust = ifelse(year == 2011, 1.08, -0.08)),
    size = 3, colour = INK
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    Rose = DIV_HIGH, Fell = DIV_LOW,
    Unchanged = "grey70", `Entered / left` = "#009E73"
  ), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:15) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.45, 0.45))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Rank by population",
    title = "Bihar overtakes Maharashtra for second place by 2036",
    caption = SRC
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

```{r district-growth-map, fig.height = 8}
dist <- population_projections_district |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, district, year, males, females, population)

dist_wide <- dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2031)) |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, district, year, population) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = population, names_prefix = "p") |>
  mutate(growth_pct = 100 * (p2031 / p2011 - 1))

states_sf <- get_census_boundaries(2011, "state")

# One 640-district join serves both choropleths.
dist_geo <- dist_wide |>
  select(state_name_harmonized, district, growth_pct) |>
  left_join(
    dist |>
      filter(year == 2031) |>
      transmute(state_name_harmonized, district, sex_ratio = 1000 * females / males),
    by = c("state_name_harmonized", "district")
  ) |>
  attach_geometry(year = 2011, geography = "district")

ggplot(dist_geo) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = growth_pct), colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = states_sf, fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = DIV_LOW, mid = DIV_MID, high = DIV_HIGH, midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-30, 60), oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Growth (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected district population growth, 2011-2031",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Census 2011 boundaries, %d districts. White = no change, grey = unmatched",
      nrow(dist_wide)
    )
  ) +
  theme_map
```

```{r district-sexratio-map, fig.height = 8}
ggplot(dist_geo) +
```

```{r district-spread, fig.height = 9}
spread <- dist_wide |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  filter(n() >= 5) |>
  mutate(med = median(growth_pct), flat = diff(range(growth_pct)) < 0.5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, med))

# States where MOHFW applied one rate to every district, read off the data.
uniform <- spread |>
  filter(flat) |>
  distinct(state_name_harmonized) |>
  pull() |>
  as.character() |>
  sort()

ggplot(spread, aes(growth_pct, state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey55", fill = "grey96", linewidth = 0.35, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.18, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.55, colour = ACCENT) +
  labs(
    x = "District growth 2011-2031 (%)", y = NULL,
    title = "Within-state spread of district growth rates",
    subtitle = paste(
      "One point per district. States with at least 5 districts, ordered by median.",
      paste(strwrap(sprintf(
        "MOHFW applied a single state-wide rate to every district in %s, so those %d states
         collapse to one value.",
        knitr::combine_words(uniform), length(uniform)
      ), width = 105), collapse = "\n"),
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r district-lorenz, fig.height = 5.5}
lorenz <- dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2011, 2031)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  arrange(population, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    cum_pop = 100 * cumsum(population) / sum(population),
    cum_dist = 100 * row_number() / n()
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(year = factor(year))

gini <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(x)
  n <- length(x)
  sum((2 * seq_len(n) - n - 1) * x) / (n^2 * mean(x))
}

gini_2011 <- gini(dist$population[dist$year == 2011])
gini_2031 <- gini(dist$population[dist$year == 2031])

ggplot(lorenz, aes(cum_dist, cum_pop, colour = year)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = year), linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("text",
    x = 62, y = 22, hjust = 0, size = 3.4, colour = INK,
    label = sprintf("Gini 2011 = %.3f\nGini 2031 = %.3f", gini_2011, gini_2031)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = YEAR_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`2011` = "solid", `2031` = "22"), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative share of districts (%)", y = "Cumulative share of population (%)",
    title = sprintf(
      "Population concentration across districts holds at a Gini of %.2f", gini_2011
    ),
    subtitle = "The 2031 curve lies on top of 2011. Grey diagonal = perfectly even distribution",
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r district-extremes, fig.height = 9}
extremes <- bind_rows(

) |>

    x = "Growth 2011-2031 (%)", y = NULL,
    title = "The 20 fastest and 20 slowest growing districts",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Panels use different x-scales: %+.0f%% at the top, %+.0f%% at the bottom",
      max(extremes$growth_pct), min(extremes$growth_pct)
    ),
    caption = SRC

```

```{r lgd-check, fig.height = 8}
lgd_ratio <- lgd |>
  filter(year == 2021) |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  summarise(lgd_sum = sum(population), districts = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(
    state |> filter(year == 2021) |> select(state_name_harmonized, state_total = population),
    by = "state_name_harmonized"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ratio = lgd_sum / state_total,
    state_name_harmonized = reorder(state_name_harmonized, ratio)
  )

ggplot(lgd_ratio, aes(ratio, state_name_harmonized)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = ratio, yend = state_name_harmonized),
    colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(colour = DIV_HIGH, size = 2.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Sum of LGD districts / state projection, 2021", y = NULL,
    title = "population_projections_district_lgd does not reconcile to the state table",
    subtitle = "Values should sit on the grey line at 1.0. Use population_projections_district instead",
    caption = SRC
  )
```

```{r claims, include = FALSE}
# The titles above make four editorial claims. If a data rebuild invalidates one,
# fail the vignette build rather than shipping a false sentence.
stopifnot(
  # "Tamil Nadu is the only state shrinking in 2036"
  identical(as.character(term$state_name_harmonized[term$shrinking]), "Tamil Nadu"),
  # "Bihar gains the most national share, Tamil Nadu loses the most"
  identical(as.character(shares$state_name_harmonized[which.max(shares$change)]), "Bihar"),
  identical(as.character(shares$state_name_harmonized[which.min(shares$change)]), "Tamil Nadu"),
  # "Uttar Pradesh and Bihar supply a third of the increment"
  identical(incr$state_name_harmonized[1:2], c("Uttar Pradesh", "Bihar")),
  round(incr$cum_share[2]) == 33,
  # "Bihar overtakes Maharashtra for second place by 2036"
  rank_data$rank[rank_data$state_name_harmonized == "Bihar" & rank_data$year == 2036] == 2
)
```
